intended_object: A projection on bit strings that pulls the first component, the unary row index, out of an encoded request word. The library uses it to compute rows of the ellipsoid direction update in polynomial time (from the docstring and module doc).
explanation: The definition just renames `machinePairFirst`, the library's own projection to the first component of a pair encoded as a bit string. It is an implementation detail of how inputs to the polynomial-time ellipsoid-update machinery are encoded. It has no standard mathematical counterpart that it could be compared against.
